prompt:
超写实办公室低机位人像摄影，竖版约 2:3。一名明确成年的东亚女性，25+，职场风穿搭，坐在现代办公室黑色滚轮椅上，摄影机几乎贴近木地板，使用 20–24mm 超广角镜头从正前方极低机位仰拍，形成非常强烈的近大远小透视。人物上半身位于画面上部，双腿向镜头方向延伸，其中一只高跟鞋距离镜头最近，占据画面下半部视觉中心。

人物留深棕黑色中长直发，长度到肩下，侧分刘海自然垂落，发尾轻微内扣。脸型偏鹅蛋形，肤色自然白皙，妆容干净克制：细眼线、自然睫毛、淡粉腮红、裸粉唇色。人物身体略向前倾，低头看向镜头，嘴唇轻微张开，表情自然放松。

身材为自然纤细偏轻沙漏型，肩部适中，腰部收束，髋部自然，大腿匀称。坐姿重点：人物坐在办公椅前缘，双腿交叉，一条腿从另一条腿前方大幅向镜头伸出，膝盖和小腿形成强烈透视；靠近镜头的脚被广角明显放大，但保持真实人体结构。另一只脚落在地面偏后方，形成前后层次。

上身穿白色长袖衬衫＋深藏蓝色修身西装马甲。白衬衫为标准翻领，袖子合身；领口系一枚浅蓝色缎面大蝴蝶结 / bow tie，带轻微丝绸光泽。外层深蓝马甲为正式商务制服感，带细窄竖纹或暗纹，双排或多枚深色纽扣，收腰明显。

下身穿同色深藏蓝超短职业裙 / 修身短裙，长度到大腿上部，坐姿时保持完整覆盖。双腿为裸腿或极薄自然肤色丝袜，整体几乎看不出明显袜色，只保留轻微丝滑质感和均匀肤色。

脚穿黑色皮革尖头细高跟鞋，鞋面为轻微哑光 / 半亮皮质，鞋头狭长，约7–9cm细跟。最靠近镜头的那只鞋鞋尖和前掌巨大近景占据画面下方，鞋底略微朝向镜头，形成明显夸张透视；另一只高跟鞋完整出现在后方木地板上。

人物左手靠近桌面或身体侧边，右手自然扶住椅子 / 桌边，姿态像办公室里随手坐下时被低机位抓拍。

场景为普通现代办公室 / 公司工位区：左侧紧邻浅色办公桌，桌面和桌板从画面左上方向下延伸；右侧可见黑色人体工学滚轮椅底座、金属椅腿和脚轮。地面为浅棕色木纹地板，带少量真实磨损、污迹和细小杂物。背景墙面和办公家具以白色、浅灰色为主。

顶部可见白色办公室天花板和长条形冷白荧光灯 / LED灯板，形成明显仰拍空间感。

光线采用办公室冷白顶灯＋环境自然光，人物脸部和白衬衫明亮，深蓝制服保留细节，高跟鞋产生柔和反光。整体不要棚拍灯光。

整体呈 高质量手机 / 无反相机低机位抓拍质感：轻微广角畸变、自然锐度、中等景深、真实皮肤纹理、低饱和商务色调。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋现代办公室＋极低机位贴地仰拍＋20–24mm超广角＋坐在滚轮办公椅＋双腿交叉＋一条腿大幅向镜头伸出＋黑色尖头细高跟鞋巨大近景＋白衬衫＋深藏蓝西装马甲＋浅蓝缎面蝴蝶结＋深蓝短裙＋浅色木地板＋办公桌和椅轮＋冷白办公室顶灯。

避免：未成年人、真实学生身份、长裤、黑色厚丝袜、网袜、运动鞋、粗跟鞋、站姿、双腿并拢、普通平视构图、过度虚化、豪华办公室、强直闪、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余腿、多余脚、畸形高跟鞋、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en:
Ultra-realistic office low-angle portrait photography, vertical orientation approximately 2:3. A clearly adult East Asian female, 25+, professional workplace style, seated on a modern black rolling office chair. The camera is positioned almost touching the wooden floor, using a 20–24mm ultra-wide-angle lens shooting upward from directly in front at an extremely low angle, creating a very dramatic near-large far-small perspective. The subject's upper body is in the upper portion of the frame, with her legs extending toward the lens; one high heel is closest to the camera, dominating the visual center of the lower half of the composition.

Her hair is dark brownish-black, medium-long and straight, falling past the shoulders with natural side-parted bangs and slight inward curls at the ends. She has an oval face shape, naturally fair skin tone, and clean, restrained makeup: fine eyeliner, natural eyelashes, pale pink blush, and nude pink lips. Her body leans slightly forward as she looks down toward the camera with lips parted subtly, exhibiting a relaxed and natural expression.

Her figure is naturally slender with a subtle hourglass contour, featuring balanced shoulders, a cinched waist, natural hips, and well-proportioned thighs. Sitting posture focus: seated at the front edge of the office chair with legs crossed, one leg extending significantly forward toward the lens in front of the other, with the knee and calf forming dramatic foreshortening; the foot closest to the lens is visibly enlarged by the wide angle while maintaining anatomically realistic structure. The other foot rests further back on the floor, creating depth between foreground and background.

Upper body: wearing a white long-sleeved dress shirt layered with a dark navy slim-fit tailored suit vest. The white shirt features a standard spread collar and fitted sleeves; at the collar is a large light-blue satin bow / bow tie with a gentle silk sheen. The outer dark navy vest has a formal business uniform feel, featuring narrow vertical pinstripes or subtle weave, double-breasted or multiple dark buttons, and noticeable waist tapering.

Lower body: wearing a matching dark navy ultra-short professional skirt / tailored miniskirt, reaching the upper thigh, maintaining full coverage while seated. Legs are bare or in ultra-thin natural skin-tone sheer pantyhose, with virtually no discernible hosiery color, retaining only a subtle silky sheen and even skin tone.

Footwear: black leather pointed-toe stiletto high heels with a subtle semi-matte / semi-gloss leather finish, narrow pointed toe, and approximately 7–9cm thin stiletto heels. The shoe tip and forefoot closest to the lens appear in a massive close-up dominating the bottom of the frame, with the sole angled slightly toward the camera, creating a pronounced exaggerated perspective; the other high heel rests completely in the background on the wood floor.

Her left hand is positioned near the desktop or beside her torso, while her right hand rests naturally on the chair / desk edge, capturing a candid, spontaneous snapshot pose as if captured while casually seated in an office.

The setting is an ordinary modern office / corporate cubicle area: directly to the left is a light-colored office desk, with the desktop and paneling extending downward from the upper left; to the right, the base of the black ergonomic swivel chair, metal chair legs, and casters are visible. The floor is light brown wood grain plank flooring showing minimal authentic wear, scuffs, and tiny flecks of dust. Background walls and office furniture consist predominantly of white and light gray tones.

The top of the frame shows a white office acoustic ceiling and linear cool-white fluorescent / LED light troffers, reinforcing the upward-angle spatial depth.

Lighting utilizes cool-white ceiling office troffers combined with natural ambient light; the subject's face and white shirt are bright, the dark navy uniform retains rich fabric detail, and the high heels catch soft reflections. Avoid studio portrait lighting entirely.

Overall visual quality presents a high-end smartphone / mirrorless camera low-angle candid capture aesthetic: subtle wide-angle barrel distortion, natural sharpness, moderate depth of field, authentic skin micro-textures, and a low-saturation corporate color palette.

Key anchors: adult East Asian woman + modern office + extreme floor-level low-angle upward shot + 20–24mm ultra-wide-angle + seated on rolling office chair + crossed legs + one leg extending far forward toward camera + massive foreground close-up of black pointed-toe stiletto high heel + white collared shirt + dark navy suit vest + light-blue satin bow tie + dark navy miniskirt + light wood plank floor + office desk and chair casters + cool-white office ceiling lights.

Avoid: minors, actual student identity, trousers, thick black tights, fishnets, sneakers, block heels, standing pose, legs pressed tightly together, ordinary eye-level framing, excessive blur/bokeh, luxury executive office, harsh direct flash, anime face, CG look, plastic skin, extra legs, extra feet, malformed high heels, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Hyper-realistic office low-angle wide-angle upward portrait of an East Asian professional woman wearing a white shirt, navy vest, and miniskirt, sitting cross-legged on a swivel chair, with black pointed-toe stiletto heels creating a dramatic near-large far-small perspective.

上身穿白色长袖衬衫＋深藏蓝色修身西装马甲。白衬衫为标准翻领，袖子合身；领口系一枚浅蓝色缎面大蝴蝶结 / bow tie，带轻微丝绸光泽。外层深蓝马甲为正式商务制服感，带细窄竖纹或暗纹，双排或多枚深色纽扣，收腰明显。

下身穿同色深藏蓝超短职业裙 / 修身短裙，长度到大腿上部，坐姿时保持完整覆盖。双腿为裸腿或极薄自然肤色丝袜，整体几乎看不出明显袜色，只保留轻微丝滑质感和均匀肤色。

脚穿黑色皮革尖头细高跟鞋，鞋面为轻微哑光 / 半亮皮质，鞋头狭长，约7–9cm细跟。最靠近镜头的那只鞋鞋尖和前掌巨大近景占据画面下方，鞋底略微朝向镜头，形成明显夸张透视；另一只高跟鞋完整出现在后方木地板上。

人物左手靠近桌面或身体侧边，右手自然扶住椅子 / 桌边，姿态像办公室里随手坐下时被低机位抓拍。

场景为普通现代办公室 / 公司工位区：左侧紧邻浅色办公桌，桌面和桌板从画面左上方向下延伸；右侧可见黑色人体工学滚轮椅底座、金属椅腿和脚轮。地面为浅棕色木纹地板，带少量真实磨损、污迹和细小杂物。背景墙面和办公家具以白色、浅灰色为主。

顶部可见白色办公室天花板和长条形冷白荧光灯 / LED灯板，形成明显仰拍空间感。

光线采用办公室冷白顶灯＋环境自然光，人物脸部和白衬衫明亮，深蓝制服保留细节，高跟鞋产生柔和反光。整体不要棚拍灯光。

整体呈 高质量手机 / 无反相机低机位抓拍质感：轻微广角畸变、自然锐度、中等景深、真实皮肤纹理、低饱和商务色调。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋现代办公室＋极低机位贴地仰拍＋20–24mm超广角＋坐在滚轮办公椅＋双腿交叉＋一条腿大幅向镜头伸出＋黑色尖头细高跟鞋巨大近景＋白衬衫＋深藏蓝西装马甲＋浅蓝缎面蝴蝶结＋深蓝短裙＋浅色木地板＋办公桌和椅轮＋冷白办公室顶灯。

避免：未成年人、真实学生身份、长裤、黑色厚丝袜、网袜、运动鞋、粗跟鞋、站姿、双腿并拢、普通平视构图、过度虚化、豪华办公室、强直闪、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余腿、多余脚、畸形高跟鞋、水印和乱码文字。
translations.en:
Photorealistic ultra-low-angle office portrait photography, vertical roughly 2:3. An adult East Asian female, 25+, dressed in professional office attire, seated on a black rolling office chair in a modern office. The camera is placed almost flush against the wooden floor, shooting upward from a very low frontal angle using a 20-24mm ultra-wide lens, creating dramatic forced perspective with strong foreground-background contrast. The subject's upper body occupies the upper frame while her legs extend forward towards the camera, with one high heel closest to the lens commanding visual attention in the lower foreground.

She has dark brownish-black straight medium-length hair falling past the shoulders with natural side-swept bangs and slightly curled ends. Oval face shape, fair and natural skin tone, subtle and refined makeup: thin eyeliner, natural lashes, light blush, nude pink lips. Slightly leaning forward, gazing down towards the camera with slightly parted lips and a relaxed, natural expression.

Slender hourglass figure with proportional shoulders and defined waistline. Seated right at the front edge of the rolling chair with legs crossed, one leg extending prominently toward the camera lens creating heavy perspective scaling on the foreground foot and ankle while maintaining anatomical accuracy; the other foot rests further back on the floor.

Wearing a long-sleeve white dress shirt paired with a tailored navy blue vest waistcoat. Classic turn-down collar with a light blue satin oversized bow tie featuring a soft silk sheen. The vest has subtle pinstripes and button detailing with a fitted silhouette. Matching navy blue professional mini skirt. Bare legs or sheer skin-toned pantyhose.

Black pointed-toe stiletto high heels (around 7-9cm). The shoe closest to the camera creates an exaggerated wide-angle close-up filling the bottom view. Left hand near desk/torso, right hand casually grasping the chair edge in a candid snapshot manner.

Scene is a realistic modern workplace cubicle setting: light office desk on the left, chair casters and chrome base on the right, light wood-grain flooring, white/light gray office walls, and bright white ceiling fluorescent strip lights overhead providing a strong upward perspective and natural office ambient lighting.
